CustomField.description: Only used when Strategy__c is RandomizeByPattern and Redact__c is unchecked. Number of characters matched by ReplacementPattern__c, counting from the end of the value, to randomize - e.g. 4 to scramble only the last 4 digits of a card number and leave the rest as real digits.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Number of matching characters (from the end of the value) to randomize. Only applies when Strategy is Randomize By Pattern and Redact is unchecked.
CustomField.label: Replacement Character Count
